name: Buyer Protection Instruction Allegement Removal Advice V 01
definition: Scope|An account servicer sends a BuyerProtectionInstructionAllegementRemovalAdvice message to an account owner to acknowledge that a previously sent Buyer Protection Instruction Allegement is no longer outstanding.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information|using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the processor of the instruction other than the account owner the account servicer and the market infrastructure.

AllegementRemovalReason.name: Allegement Removal Reason
AllegementRemovalReason.definition: Reason for the removal of the buyer protection allegement.
